steps.name: Step 1 — Navigate to Settings -> Notifications: page loads, table body visible and non-empty
Step 2 — From the list-fetch response, select the first 2 unread (is_seen=false) rows and record the current page's full baseline
Step 3 — Check the checkbox on the two selected (unread) notifications: both become checked, toolbar toggle button enables with label 'Mark selected as read'
Step 4 — Click the mark-toggle button ('Mark selected as read'): PUT resolves 200, success toast appears, selection clears and the button reverts to disabled
Step 5 — From the refetch response: both selected notifications are now is_seen=true; every other row on the page is unchanged
Step 6 — Reload the page: both notifications remain is_seen=true (persisted)
Step 7 — Check the checkbox on the SAME two notifications (now read) again: both become checked, toolbar toggle button's label is now 'Mark selected as unread'
Step 8 — Click the mark-toggle button ('Mark selected as unread'): PUT resolves 200, success toast appears, selection clears and the button reverts to disabled
